summary: The DestProfilePrfRequirements file focuses on managing requirements associated with destination profiles, particularly prerequisites. It supports adding, editing, and managing prerequisite options such as Standard, Document, and Link types with validation and dynamic UI adjustments.
purpose: To enable the management of destination profile requirements by providing mechanisms to add, edit, and delete requirements while ensuring prerequisite options are handled properly.

workflows.name: Delete Requirement
steps: Requirement is removed from the system.

business_rules: Only standard, document, and link types are allowed for prerequisites.
Hidden items and omitted codes are filtered out from requirement lists.
If no sub-disciplines are selected, apply prerequisites to all disciplines.
validations: Ensure fields are not left empty before submission.
Confirm file uploads meet specified criteria for Document type.
conditions: Different behaviors for Standard, Document, and Link prerequisite options.
system_behavior: Dynamically adjust form fields based on prerequisite option selected.
Display warnings if required selections are missing.
Handle file uploads for Document prerequisite option.
dependencies: Disciplines module for managing sub-discipline selections.
exceptions: Cancel operation if user session is not available.
Raise exceptions if necessary prerequisite criteria are not met.
